records.title: No. 9 Park
records.operator: Barbara Lynch; Lorraine Tomlinson-Hall, COO, Barbara Lynch Collective
records.quote: Lynch said in a statement on the closures that she and her fellow shareholders were not positioned to make the investment required. COO Lorraine Tomlinson-Hall confirmed No. 9 Park would shut down after service on December 31.
records.note: Nine is a different restaurant. Do not rewrite this case file onto ninerg.com or any later occupant of 9 Park Street.
